messages:
Dina Patel: quick ux q — for the automatic fallback thing (the policy that silently flips to cheaper model / degrade mode), how do folks feel about visibility? i want auditability but not a million noisy alerts.

Kevin Wu: +1 on auditability. idea: compact 'safety slate' in console — shows last 3 fallback events per route, reason short (eg 5xx spike / quality drop), and a single CTA to 'open incident trail'. toast only for operator-facing routes. :thinking_face:

Alex Moreno: i like the slate idea. also add a tiny timeline pill you can expand; default collapsed. when expanded show: timestamp, trigger metric, sample request id, model variant switched-to.

Samir Rao: do we also surface the policy snippet that caused it? small read-only JSON view with fuzzy-matching to the policy that fired. then you can click "replay" in sandbox.

Dina Patel: yeah replay is huge. UX question: should we surface the full policy by default or a redacted summary? security teams hate PII in traces.

Lina H.: redact by default. show policy id + summary + link to auditors-only view that includes full policy and change history. includes who last edited + commit id.

Kevin Wu: s/o to ops-bot for audit events — can we attach a short deterministic fingerprint to each fallback event so we can join logs across infra? e.g. `fallback:event:<sha256>`

ops-bot: automated note — sample event payload: ```
{
  "event_id": "fallback:event:af3b7c",
  "route": "/chat/v1",
  "trigger": "latency_p95>1200ms",
  "action": "switch_to_variant:opt-256q",
  "snapshot_id": "snap-2026-03-21-17:12:03"
}
```

Alex Moreno: thumbs on fingerprint. also UX sidenote: in rollout flows, we should show an expected TTL for a fallback (eg auto-recover after 5m) and allow operator to extend or pin it. prevents oscillation.

Samir Rao: agree but need guardrails — pin should require two clicks and an audit rationale text field. otherwise people will pin and forget.

Dina Patel: question for product: do we show a little "why-you-saw-this" microcopy in app level telemetry? e.g., "results came from fallback model due to model memory exhaustion" — helps debugging downstream.

Lina H.: microcopy fine but must be configurable per-customer (some customers don't want debug info in user-facing responses).

Kevin Wu: another thing — surface the sampling of example requests we collected when the fallback fired. show 3 anonymized examples (hash request id + first 100 chars). privacy scrubbed.

Dina Patel: proposal for console widgets: 
- Safety Slate (collapsed) per-route 
- Expandable event timeline with fingerprint + policy snippet + anonymized samples 
- Replay button that opens sandbox with the captured payloads 
- Operator pin with enforced audit rationale

Alex Moreno: i can mock the slate UI this week. quick API question: what endpoint will provide the event list? `GET /internal/v1/fallbacks?route=...&since=...`?

Samir Rao: yep that's the plan. returns array of events (id, fingerprint, policy_id, summary, snapshot_link). will also include boolean `can_view_full_policy`.

Dina Patel: awesome. prioritize: mock -> minimal API -> ops-bot wiring -> privacy redaction. thanks. :rocket: 

Lina H.: tagging @product for signoff on pin UX and privacy knobs.

Kevin Wu: can we add an acceptance criterion: every fallback event must be queryable via event id within 7 days and exportable as CSV for auditors.

Dina Patel: adding that to the spec. end of thread for now — will post mock soon.
